author: Insta360
description:
@zimydakid and @deepseaguardians are helping deploy GPS satellite tags on endangered mako sharks to better understand their migration patterns and support conservation efforts.

But ocean conservation isn't just for scientists. Submit your shark and ray sightings to the @padiaware Global Shark & Ray Census to help protect vulnerable species. Past dives count. 

Join the movement at https://pros-blog.padi.com/introducing-the-global-shark-ray-census-padi-awares-newest-citizen-science-program/.
